lines.text: As we enter Eden,
we're greeted by familiar sights.
In the distance, I see a child racing toward me at full speed.
With a bright smile and arms spread wide, the child leaps and throws herself into my arms.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hug me!
I wrap my arms around the child as she leaps into my embrace.
She nuzzles her cheek against me, seemingly delighted.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hehe. It's warm. Feels good.
There, there. Have you been doing well?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Uh-huh!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Look at her, running straight into his arms. Unbelievable.
You're all here.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yeah. We made it.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: How are things?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh... Th-there are people I don't recognize...

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: What a strange sight, seeing the Four Beasts in Eden.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: I know, right?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: ... Hmm. All we've ever done is fight them. But since everything's been resolved, we should at least go say hi.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Shall we?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Hey, Leviathan. Your forehead's looking even shinier than usual. Care for a sparkle-off with me?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wh-why you...!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Your claws haven't changed a bit, Behemoth. Bet you can't lift my weapon with those flimsy things though.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Oh, really now?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Don't pick a fight. They're weak, so it's easy to get a rise out of them.
... I apologize on their behalf.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha. You guys are still as delightful as ever.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: It's your first time meeting Ziz and Bahamut, isn't it?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Go on, say hello.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh... H-hello... I-I'm Ziz.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Nice to meet you, Ziz. You can call me Neon.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: You seem shy, but your figure says otherwise... Definitely the type people can't get enough of.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh, wh-what?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Never mind. I'm Anis.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Pleasure to meet you. You may address me as the Wise Bahamut.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oh, then you can call me Neo-Neon.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: And you can call me Star Anis.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I'll commit it to memory. After all, I, the knowledgeable Bahamut, have an excellent memory.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Forgive my bluntness, but how would you rate your own level of knowled—

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: All right! Now that everyone's here, I believe there's something we have to discuss?
Oh, right. I was hoping everyone could gather a bit closer, but...
The child clinging to me refuses to budge.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Heheh. Hehehe.
Seeing her beaming smile, I can't help but smile too.
... But I can't shake the feeling that I'm forgetting something important...

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: So this is the Queen the Four Beasts created? She's tiny.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: You're right. I was expecting a Queen to look a lot more intimidating.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Speaking of which, she's awfully fond of the Commander. She's stuck to him like glue...

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: ... Isn't that Rapi?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: ... That kid looks just like Rapi.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Eh? No way. Rapi isn't nearly as cute and adorable.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: And the size difference is way too... Wait, that is Rapi.

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Oh my, you're right. No wonder I thought she looked familiar.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Hmm... They do look alike.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: You're right... Now that you've pointed it out, the resemblance is uncanny.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: R-right? I knew I couldn't be the only one who felt that way.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: ... What in the world is going on?
Oh...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Heh.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hehehehehe.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: The time has finally come to reveal the secret I've kept hidden for so long.
I completely forgot to explain the whole situation.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Well, little one, who's this wonderful person you're hugging?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Daddy! Daddy!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: ... Oh my.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: ... Come again?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: And who am I?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Mommy! Mommy!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: What!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Huh?!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Oh my goodness! Oh my goodness!

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: What...!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's right. Mommy and Daddy.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hehe! Mommy! Daddy!
Rapi flips her hair with a smug, self-satisfied look.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Well, that's how things turned out.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Wh-what on earth are you talking about? Haha. Th-this isn't funny at all.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: C-C-C-Commander, Rapi said something really strange.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Why... why aren't you saying anything... Well? Well?!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: N-Neon. Say something, please.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Well, I expected something like this from you eventually, Master.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Don't just go along with it! Say something else other than that!

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: G-good heavens... so it's actually possible? I thought it was all just a baseless rumor floating around the Ark.

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: Walk us through the process. Tell us how this came to be.

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: That comment sounds highly inappropriate.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Mommy! Daddy!
All right. I'll explain everything, so listen up.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: This child is mine and the Commander's.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Don't be absurd! Y-you said she's a Queen!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's right. Our child is a Queen.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: The timeline doesn't add up! She's not a newborn!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We raised her with love, so she grew up healthy and strong.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: I know love can work miracles, but come on! Even miracles have their limits!
Everyone, that's not entirely accurate. To make a long story short, she's not my child...

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: You pathetic excuse for a man. At least have the courage to take responsibility for your actions.
No, you've got it all wrong...!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What do you mean by that? Are you saying you don't intend to take responsibility?

lines.speaker: papillon
lines.text: Oh my. Can someone go get some popcorn?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Argh, shut up! All of you, be quiet!

lines.speaker: johan
lines.text: I never thought I'd hear you say something like that, but I agree.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Bahamut. Explain. I can't take this racket any longer!

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: All right. Everyone, calm down. I, the enlightened Bahamut, will explain the birth of this child.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: The Young Man's ***** entered Rapi's body, thus giving birth to this child.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Anis. You shouldn't start cursing just because of this.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Do you have the slightest idea of what I'm going through right now?! Any idea at all?!

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Calm down. I don't think we've heard the whole story yet.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Fine, I'll just explain it myself. Otherwise, you'll only make an even bigger scene.
... Leviathan wraps up her explanation.
Thanks to her somewhat dry but highly objective explanation, free of any personal opinion...
Calm is restored to Eden, which has been a complete madhouse.
... I feel nothing but relief.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, the knowledgeable Bahamut, will provide additional explanation regarding the extraction of the core materials.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: First, the pants—

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: All right. That's enough about this.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Urgh... Are you trying to deprive everyone of the knowledge they deserve to know?
... Please don't tell everyone. I'm begging you.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: ... Anis, are you okay? You're snapping one second and dead quiet the next. It's actually a little scary.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Leave her be. She needs time to recover from the shock.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Isn't that right, baby?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: Hehe. Mommy, Mommy.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hehe. So cute. I wonder who she gets it from?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Oh, of course. She must take after me and the Commander. I'm really something else, huh.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: ... So to summarize...

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Nothing happened. Is that right?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Anis, denial isn't the answer. I know you're in shock, but turning away from reality won't do you any good.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Nothing happened. Right?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Rien.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Oh là là, you've suddenly become Mustang?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Think of this as an "act first, report later" kind of situation.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: That doesn't apply to a situation like this!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Whatever. Forget about it.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Haha. Man, you really scared me there.
Anis extends a hand toward the child in my arms.
She pokes the child's cheek with her finger.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: ... She's cute.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: So, what's her name?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: She's Wise Bahamut the Second.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: What? You haven't even named her yet?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Then should I give her a name? Believe it or not, I'm pretty good at coming up with—

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Huh? Y-you don't want that? Why not?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I can't have a name yet.

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: I haven't decided.
The child slips out of my arms,
then scampers off somewhere.
...? Where are you going?

lines.speaker: onlyone_c
lines.text: To see the sleeping girl.
The child disappears through the door.
I turn to Leviathan, looking for an explanation.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... She went to see Marian.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Marian?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: She goes to see her every chance she gets. Then she just sits there, talking to herself.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm not entirely sure, but I get the feeling they share some kind of connection as Queens.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: She never tells us what it is, though.
... Is Marian still in the same condition?

lines.speaker: cecil
lines.text: Yes. She's still alive... technically.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Once we're done talking, let's all go see her together.

lines.speaker: neon_v
lines.text: Yeah. If we all go together, she might suddenly come around.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah. Let's do that.
All right then, gather around, everyone.
I'll fill you in on the Ark's stance and the current situation.
